items.prompt: Why is Jack interested in investigating seed germination?

options.text: He may do a module on a related topic later on.
He wants to have a career in plant science.
He is thinking of choosing this topic for his dissertation.

items.prompt: Jack and Emma agree the main advantage of their present experiment is that it can be

options.text: described very easily.
carried out inside the laboratory.
completed in the time available.

items.prompt: What do they decide to check with their tutor?

options.text: whether their aim is appropriate

options.text: The diagrams of plant development are useful.
